thought.text: Ports are consistent now. Starting all three dev servers via `just serve`:

reasoning_content: Ports are now consistent: app=38489, cms=45423, boards=43781, and nginx.conf points to all three. Now start all three via `just serve` (with open stdin via /dev/zero). Memory is 5.6GB free — three builds (3×1.5GB) + containers (2GB) should fit. If it starves again, I'll fall back to sequential with the new consistent ports.

action.command:
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/just-serve2.log
setsid nohup just serve < /dev/zero > /tmp/just-serve2.log 2>&1 &
echo "serve pid $!"; sleep 15; tail -3 /tmp/just-serve2.log
